objective: Reconcile raw Zenodo g/r photometry row counts and SNR candidate membership against all 781,602 Table2 objects, with explicit Table4 crosswalk and 55 complete-metadata controls.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Table4 crosswalk contains 730,184 unique Table2 Seq IDs; candidate set contains 741,786; candidate-only residuals are 11,602; published-only IDs are zero.
The four positive fields gmag, rmag, Per-g and Per-r select all 730,184 Table4 IDs inside the reconstructed candidate set, with zero Table4 omissions.
Across all 781,602 parent objects, 730,239 pass the four-field predicate; the additional 55 are the fixed four_field_only controls and are not in the reconstructed candidate set.

A pinned raw-archive audit of the 55 controls is PARTIAL: only one has g-band rows, 51 have r-band rows, and no control has both bands represented. Raw row counts match Table2 Ng for one object and Nr for 51 objects.
The 55-control report explicitly warns that row-count mismatches must be resolved before interpreting the apparent SNR failure.
The Zenodo raw fields are documented as SourceID, RAdeg, DEdeg, MJD, mag, e_mag and flag; g_flag/r_flag have not been proven equivalent to DR2 catflags.

change.proposed: Run a single-pass, checksummed scan of all 781,602 Table2 SourceIDs against both raw Zenodo archives. Count raw and numeric-valid rows, evaluate SNR formula and flag-policy comparators, and compare per-object counts with Table2 Ng/Nr.
change.scope: Research-only script, tests, workflow and evidence artifacts; no production selector, model, feature schema or baseline changes.
change.rationale: The 55 complete-metadata controls have missing raw rows in at least one band. A full-parent row-count reconciliation is required to distinguish SNR filtering from archive incompleteness or SourceID mapping errors.

expected_improvement: Verify all raw archive rows, member sizes, row counts, CRC and SHA-256.
Produce per-object raw/valid/SNR/flag counts for all 781,602 parent IDs.
Compare SNR candidate sets with the reconstructed 741,786 candidate IDs and the 730,184 Table4 reference.
Quantify Table2 Ng/Nr versus raw row-count differences by membership cohort.
Identify all discrepant SourceIDs for follow-up coordinate and image-quality tracing.

evidence: Workflow 43600721277 completed successfully on a standard ubuntu-latest runner.
All 781,602 parent Table2 IDs were processed with object-level results.
Both raw Zenodo archive SHA-256 values and decompressed member SHA-256/size/row-count/CRC checks passed.
Approximate, exact and inverse-error SNR formula candidate counts matched at 741,786.
The full-parent object reconciliation TSV contains 781,602 rows; the row-count mismatch TSV contains 100 objects.
No production selector, model, feature schema or v0.2.0 baseline was changed.

root_causes: The reconstructed two-band SNR selector still has 11,602 candidate-only objects relative to Table4.
Four-field completeness separates Table4 exactly within the reconstructed candidate set, but this remains an empirical downstream-completeness explanation rather than a published selection rule.

The 55 four-field-only controls have positive Table2 Ng/Nr, yet the Zenodo attachments contain no dual-band raw rows: 54/55 have no g rows and 4/55 have no r rows; cross-tab: 51 r-only, 3 neither, 1 g-only, 0 both.
Raw/Table2 count mismatches remain for 100 parent IDs: 14 residuals, 55 controls, 26 Table4 members and 5 other-parent objects.
limitations: Raw Zenodo attachments do not contain image-level INFOBITS.
Zenodo g_flag/r_flag are not proven equivalent to DR2 catflags.

The CDS ReadMe lists 89,697,393 records for both ztf2g.dat and ztf2r.dat, while the checksum-pinned r archive stream in run 43600721277 contained 109,971,576 records. This source-documentation/data-version discrepancy requires verification.
A raw-row count mismatch does not prove low SNR, duplicate observations, or incorrect source identity; the exact rows and coordinates must be traced.
An exact empirical match between SNR plus four-field completeness and Table4 does not prove publisher intent.

findings: The full-parent scan confirms the 11,602 candidate-only membership partition on all 781,602 objects.
Approximate, exact and inverse-error SNR formulas produce the same 741,786 candidate set on this pinned archive revision.
The tested flag<32768 and flag!=32768 diagnostics do not change the candidate set; flag==0 removes 5,472 published Table4 members and is invalid as a reconstruction rule.
Four-field completeness yields exactly Table4 within the SNR candidate set, but also identifies 55 complete-metadata objects outside that set.
The Zenodo raw attachment coverage does not reconcile with Table2 Ng/Nr for 100 objects, including the 55 controls and some published Table4 members.
Image-level INFOBITS and the g_flag/r_flag-to-catflags mapping remain unavailable or unverified.

open_blockers: Trace the 55 controls with missing raw rows using Table2 coordinates and nearby raw SourceIDs.
Inspect raw HJD/MJD values, duplicate epochs, coordinate scatter, flags and photometric errors for all 100 mismatch IDs.
Resolve the 14 residuals and 26 Table4 row-count mismatches against original DR2 data products.
Verify the apparent r-band member row-count difference between the CDS ReadMe and the checksum-pinned Zenodo archive.
Recover image-level INFOBITS and prove whether Zenodo g_flag/r_flag represent catflags.
Reconstruct the exact Chen pipeline stage-by-stage and complete full-source membership validation.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not call the 55 controls low-SNR failures while their raw rows are absent from the attachments.
Do not infer official selector intent from exact count matching.
Do not equate g_flag/r_flag with catflags without field-level proof.
Do not change production selector or v0.2.0 baseline.
Prioritize coordinate/epoch provenance tracing for all 100 mismatch objects.
